_meta.change: CSLS hubness persisted to a memories.hubness column, refreshed by dream, instead of recomputed on every cold start
_meta.harness: tests/bench_replay.py for quality, /usr/bin/time -l on the real CLI for cost

the_problem.what: compute_hubness is an O(n^2) matmul plus a full per-row sort over the whole corpus.
the_problem.why_it_mattered: weighted_best is the SHIPPING default and calls _get_hubness. The CLI spawns cold on every invocation and the topic-recall hook runs a search per prompt, so this was paid on every single search.
the_problem.the_benchmarks_hid_it: bench_replay reuses one MemoryStore instance, so the in-process cache is warm after query 1. The published 6.2ms p50 for +best is a warm-cache artifact; the real cold cost was 1.3s.

projected.note: The docstring's own ceiling was ~10k docs. At 20k the matrix alone is 1.5GB before the sort copy.

cost_by_fusion_single_run.reading: After the change CSLS is free: weighted_best is indistinguishable from plain weighted.

quality_precheck_200_real_queries.rule: persistence must not move a single metric, or it is a ranking change wearing a performance change's clothes
quality_precheck_200_real_queries.verdict: Identical to three decimal places on every config and every metric. Passed.

semantics.null_is_neutral: A memory written since the last refresh has NULL hubness and scores 0.0 — no CSLS penalty. That is the neutral value, not a random one, so a fresh memory is never demoted for lacking a score.
semantics.fallback: A store where NO row has hubness (never refreshed) still computes on demand, so an un-upgraded DB ranks correctly, just slowly. `memory admin refresh-hubness` fixes it immediately; dream does it automatically.
semantics.refresh_point: dream, after the passes that add and soft-delete memories. Adds ~2.6s to a dream run, which is backgrounded and throttled.

honest_limits.staleness: Hubness now drifts between dreams. It is a mean top-10 neighbour cosine over thousands of vectors, so a handful of new memories barely moves it — but this is an assumption, not a measurement. If dream stops running, hubness silently ages.
honest_limits.single_corpus: Measured on one 5908-memory store. The O(n^2) claim is structural, the specific milliseconds are not portable.
honest_limits.did_not_test_20k: The 1.5GB projection at n=20000 is arithmetic on the matrix size, not a run.
